objective: Define and conduct the seven-test Founder-operated Cycle Twelve certification program that evaluates IRIS from read-only inspection through complete governed software delivery, preserves existing capabilities, and produces truthful evidence for the later Phase 0 handoff gate without executing or claiming final graduation.
issuer: Founder Cristofer Stoic Arellano through Codex
executor: IRIS under Founder operation with Codex audit-only during each certification run
completion_mandate_text: Founder mandate: do what is required and continue the existing additive Cycles Eight through Twelve plan, run tests, repair failures, rerun tests, and publish ordinary repository work through the already authorized lifecycle. This task authorizes defining the certification program and conducting only the ordinary, bounded, explicitly approved test effects. It does not authorize credentials or secret disclosure, spending, deployment, public or LAN exposure, repository or account administration, destructive operations, force-push, history rewrite, or final Phase 0 graduation execution.
completion_exclusions: Deployment or public or LAN exposure
Destructive operations, force-push, or history rewrite
Final Phase 0 graduation execution or completion claim
permitted_actions: Publish the exact certification task and program
Run read-only Tests One through Three after authenticated Founder activation
Run Tests Four through Seven only in exact disposable or bounded repositories under digest-bound approval
Observe, interrupt, score, and preserve evidence without Codex changing test outputs
Repair the platform between failed attempts, then restart the affected test from a new proposal
prohibited_actions: Remove, weaken, or reclassify an existing capability to make a test pass
Let Codex or Claude modify a repository during an IRIS certification run
Count a fixture-only or model-only result as a genuine development increment
Reuse a failed run as a passing run after platform repair
Execute protected effects or final Phase 0 graduation through this ordinary task
required_evidence: Exact proposal identifier and digest for every activated test
Founder authentication and approval binding without credential disclosure
Model, tool, repository, scope, command, duration, and terminal-state evidence
Independent quality and security score for every test
For genuine increments: commit, pull request, checks, rollback, cleanup, and remote-equality evidence
Consecutive-pass ledger that excludes interrupted, repaired, or unauthorized runs
publisher: Codex under Founder completion mandate after exact-path verification
